explanation_template: Dairy products may reduce absorption of some antibiotics such as tetracyclines or fluoroquinolones.
advice_template: Consider separating dairy and the medicine by 2–4 hours if advised.

explanation_template: Milk contains calcium which may bind with certain antibiotics and reduce absorption.
advice_template: Avoid taking milk close to antibiotic doses if relevant.

explanation_template: Iron supplements or foods may reduce absorption of levothyroxine.
advice_template: Take levothyroxine on an empty stomach and separate iron by several hours.

explanation_template: Food intake may reduce absorption of levothyroxine.
Vitamin K–rich foods may affect warfarin activity.
advice_template: Maintain consistent intake rather than avoiding completely.

explanation_template: Spinach contains vitamin K which may influence warfarin effect.
advice_template: Keep intake consistent and monitor INR.

explanation_template: Alcohol can increase drowsiness and sedation when combined with certain medicines.
advice_template: Avoid alcohol while taking sedating medications.

explanation_template: Calcium-containing foods or supplements may reduce absorption of some antibiotics.
Soy products may reduce absorption of levothyroxine in some cases.
advice_template: Avoid consuming soy close to medication time.

explanation_template: High carbohydrate meals may influence blood glucose control when using antidiabetic drugs.
advice_template: Monitor glucose and follow dietary advice.

explanation_template: Taking certain painkillers on an empty stomach may cause gastric irritation.
advice_template: Consider taking with food if recommended.

explanation_template: Skipping meals while using some diabetes medications may lead to low blood sugar.
Some antibiotics may cause gastrointestinal discomfort depending on timing.
advice_template: Follow instructions given with the medicine.

explanation_template: Food may reduce absorption of iron supplements.
advice_template: Taking on an empty stomach may improve absorption if tolerated.

explanation_template: Some vitamins are better absorbed with food.
advice_template: Taking with meals may improve absorption.

explanation_template: Food may affect how quickly some antibiotics are absorbed.
Food intake may reduce absorption of thyroid medications.
Dizziness may occur if medication is taken without adequate food intake.
Caffeine may increase anxiety symptoms and potentially counteract treatment effects.
Alcohol may enhance sedative effects and increase drowsiness.
High sugar intake may affect blood glucose control.
High sodium intake may increase blood pressure.
Grapefruit may affect metabolism of certain statins.
Alcohol may worsen side effects of antidepressants.
Smoking may worsen asthma symptoms and reduce treatment effectiveness.
Nausea may be related to how the medicine was taken or food interactions.
advice_template: Adjust timing and consult advice if symptoms persist.

explanation_template: Stomach pain may occur if taken without food.
Dizziness may be due to low blood sugar.
Drowsiness may be increased due to alcohol interaction.
Variation in vitamin K intake may affect anticoagulation.
Alcohol may interact with many medications.
High-fat meals may delay absorption of some drugs.
High fiber foods may slow absorption of certain medications.
Missing doses may reduce effectiveness of treatment.
Taking extra doses may increase risk of side effects.
